'''F-25-OJSx''', also known simply as '''F-25''',<ref name="Star Tours" /> was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]]<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours" /> [[F series repair droid]]<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours" /> with [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] and silver plating, with a red trim.<ref name="Star Tours" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]],<ref name="KOTHB">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> he was employed by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency as a "[[Spacecap Droid]]" at their [[Tomorrowland Starport]],<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours" /> where he worked in the hanger as a coat check.<ref name="Star Tours" /> He was easily spotted by his red cap and bowtie.<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Handles baggage for passengers. Easily spotted by his red cap and bowtie.|"Spacecap Droid"'s description in ''Complete Guide to Star Tours''|<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours" />}}
F-25-OJSx was created for [[Tokyo Disneyland]]'s [[Wikipedia:Simulator ride|simulator ride]] [[Wikipedia:Amusement park|theme park]] attraction [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']], which opened on [[July 12]], [[1989]]. He, alongside [[F-29-PSKx]], were the only F series droids in the ride to not be identified by name on the "Spot the Droid" posters<ref name="Star Tours" /> or in ''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]'', being instead only identified as "Spacecap Droid" and "Passenger Droid," respectively.<ref name="Complete Guide to Star Tours" /> In ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', the ride's sequel, a modified F-25 has now been moved further inside the queue, though his name is no longer visible. The droid and two others have been posed in a similar manner to a [[W:c:Disney:Hitchhiking Ghosts|trio of ghosts]] seen at the end of the [[Wikipedia:Haunted Mansion|Haunted Mansion]] ride in various Disney theme parks.<ref name="The Adventures Continue">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>
